parameters.content:
## MH OP Operations Automation

Attach these credentials after import: `MH OP Internal API` (HTTP Header Auth: Authorization / Bearer ADMIN_API_TOKEN), `MH OP Event Webhook` (HTTP Header Auth: x-mhop-automation-key / N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET), `MH OP Customer Telegram`, and `MH OP Ops Telegram`. Set GADGETOS_URL and TELEGRAM_STAFF_CHAT_ID. Import the separate error handler and select it in Workflow Settings. The application remains the only customer-bot Telegram webhook owner.

### Cart recovery · scans every 15 minutes
Valid private Telegram recipients only; one reminder attempt per lead, including after stage changes. This scan cadence does not guarantee a 15-minute delay after cart creation.

### Authenticated operational events
Attach the MH OP Event Webhook Header Auth credential. This workflow verifies the shared header, not the additional HMAC signature. Use HTTPS in production. Cross-run deduplication records processing attempts before sending: review failed executions manually; it is not guaranteed delivery.

Internal requests use Header Auth, explicit 15-second timeouts, and three retries. Failed executions are retained; successful production payloads are not.

### 21–30 day follow-up
Only verified Telegram orders inside the API purchase-age window qualify. No coupon promise: checkout does not implement voucher redemption. Recipients are deduplicated within each scan and order references across executions.
